title: An Assessment of the Polymorphism of Small Extracellular Vesicles Isolated from Gastric Juice by Cryo-Electron Microscopy
content: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are nanoscale particles covered by a lipid membrane that are found in many physiological fluids. The EVs, and especially the small EVs (sEVs), are strongly involved in both physiological and pathological processes, and their contents have been extensively studied in the search for various biomarkers.
